title: Unit09 two shin-section rebuild attempts reject promotion
summary: Revisited locally available older 128x262 Unit 09 static practice drawing, constructed two distinct lower-leg A/B native-pixel corrections after a joint/silhouette inspection, and visualized both enlarged against the old figure. Candidate A changed 996 pixel positions, B 1055. Byte-identical upper+knee rows 0..211 and boot rows 245..261, 0/255 alpha and matching bbox all validated. Visual quality gate FAILED: excessive horizontal knee seam, shins still broad/flat and weak taper, full anatomy still too simple. Critical provenance: latest hourly v4b checkpoint was NOT available in active chat, so A/B are isolated practice and MUST NOT replace v4b or be called the new best. Next priority is reopening actual v4b then resolving knee/shin/ankle form with a real skeleton/section edit. No user art uploaded publicly.
